latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release featuring command semantic classification into READ, WRITE, WRITE_SYSTEM, NETWORK, and DESTRUCTIVE levels.
- Automatically allows safe (READ/WRITE in workspace) commands; prompts user confirmation for riskier or destructive actions.
- Provides safer alternatives and clear risk explanations before executing sensitive commands.
- Remembers user security preferences across sessions to streamline workflow.
- Always intercepts highly dangerous actions, regardless of user preferences.
